$Comment: A Pumpkin Fiend: a small pumpkin-headed creature of vines that comes at you in a pack, weak alone and quick to fall. It wears the Kweebec Sapling's body and moves (its look, Hallows_Eve_Pumpkin_Fiend, is a Kweebec_Sapling child), and it fights with the sapling's own spear moves: Attack is Root_Hallows_Eve_Pumpkin_Fiend_Attack, which chains the Kweebec Razorleaf's left swing, right swing and stab, with the Razorleaf's Leaf Spear in hand. The sapling's only attacker, the Razorleaf, stands on Template_Kweebec_Razorleaf, which never turns on a player unprovoked, so the fiend is a Variant of Template_Intelligent, the hostile template the Jack Skeleton stands on, and this Modify is Skeleton_Fighter's own (a Variant's Modify reaches only the Parameters its immediate Reference declares, and any other key makes the game refuse the whole role). Changed from that file: the look, the drop list, the nameplate, the weapon and the attack; MaxHealth 30 and a 6 damage hit (Melee_Damage) for a weak add; DisableDamageGroups Self and Skeleton, so neither another fiend nor any skeleton fighting beside it hurts it; the template's own death puff in place of bones; its Memories leaves replaced by IsMemory false, and its call for help to skeletons left out; and the wandering values written in place of the ones that file computes, as the Jack Skeleton writes them. FlockArray lets fiends arrive in small packs. This is the wild fiend: it spawns only through this pack's calendar rules (CalendarSpawns/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Fiend_Spawns.json). The ones the Headless Horseman's pumpkins hatch in his fight are the same creature under ids of their own with more health, Hallows_Eve_Pumpkin_Fiend_Hatchling on the normal ride (MaxHealth 60) and Hallows_Eve_Pumpkin_Fiend_Hatchling_HM on the hard one (130), because his fight waits on and clears every member of Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Adds_Group near it, and a wild fiend must never be one of them; so this role stays out of that group. Keep the three files' Modify the same except MaxHealth and FlockArray. A kill pays Hallowed favor (all three are in Hallows_Eve_Event_Mobs), and Old Jack's fiend jobs count all three.
